svg.title: Ruth's pattern: cut larger
svg.desc: A later sheet: the same six pieces cut larger, the first size ghosted inside them, Mabel's pencil still writing 7; a thimble and pins on the tissue, and six of Ruth's marks along the selvage ("When company goes I am cold, and Mother cuts again.").

g.text: No. 2 · six seams · same as before, larger
